items.title: Painting 1990s anime scenes in Python
items.summary: You can paint 1990s cel-and-gouache anime stills from scratch in Python, with no image model and no external textures. One 3D camera warps flat painted panels into depth while shared sunlight, tapered PyCairo ink, gouache grain, and 35mm optics finish the frame.
